tasks.scope: Configure the OUT-01 main Merge Template layout when its proposed scope and G08 details are approved. Show inspection program/source, establishment/context, key dates and categorical results. Clearly distinguish a Draft record from final accepted output. IMP-57 adds the response, review, action and photograph sections. Create the approved definition, or update the same-purpose existing definition only when G08 identifies it. For an existing definition, update the specified fields, filters, grouping, visibility and generation/storage settings.
accept: Approved branding and the correct program/source/context appear.
Performance, submission and acceptance dates retain their distinct meanings.
Draft and accepted outputs are visibly distinguishable.
tasks.reviewer: Senior Consultant — product build manager (separate qualified reviewer)
tasks.rationale: This assignment needs independent configuration judgment for conditional screens, calculations or standard workflow rules. A separate Senior Consultant product build manager reviews the result.
tasks.deliverable: A branded main template ready for the approved supporting evidence sections.
tasks.blocked: Waiting for supplied inputs: G08 — Approved report definitions, native history connections, branding, template content/photos, file storage, retention/versioning and any approved signature requirements. Requires the configured outputs of IMP-05, IMP-08, IMP-09, IMP-14. Predecessors also depend on G03, G02, G04.
configurationRows: Apply the supplied G08 branding and field connections in the native Merge Template.
Use the specified source, program, context, performance/submission/acceptance dates and result fields.
Make Draft versus accepted status visible. Use current specified fields and existing native template behavior.

tasks.title: Configure Inspection Record Evidence Sections
tasks.objective: Include the approved responses, review evidence, actions and photographs in the portable record.
tasks.scope: Configure the OUT-01 supporting sections using the supplied native G08 child-record, history and photograph settings. Internal inspections show their checklist content; External inspections show their report context. Apply conditional layouts using the existing relationships. Create the approved definition, or update the same-purpose existing definition only when G08 identifies it. For an existing definition, update the specified fields, filters, grouping, visibility and generation/storage settings.
accept: Responses, review context, actions and photographs render through supported native settings.
External output contains its report context without fabricated checklist answers.
Photographs are readable and hidden-question behavior remains consistent with the application.

tasks.title: Configure Portable Inspection Record Generation
tasks.objective: Generate and store the approved portable record from an accepted inspection.
tasks.scope: Configure OUT-01 generation using the supplied G08 native file, metadata, storage and versioning policy. Generate final output from accepted content, retain its source inspection and generation time in native metadata, and handle regeneration according to the approved policy. Create the approved definition, or update the same-purpose existing definition only when G08 identifies it. For an existing definition, update the specified fields, filters, grouping, visibility and generation/storage settings.
accept: Final output is generated from accepted content and identifies its source and generation time.
Storage and regeneration follow the supplied policy.
Regeneration does not silently overwrite an official record contrary to that policy.
tasks.reviewer: Senior Consultant — product build manager (separate qualified reviewer)
tasks.rationale: The configuration connects related records or native functions; it requires care to preserve the intended source, result and workflow behavior. A separate Senior Consultant product build manager reviews the result.
tasks.deliverable: Accepted inspection records can be generated and stored under the approved native output policy.
